first.rationale: Current declines in activation (6% QoQ) and onboarding completion (4% QoQ) directly map to the proven levers in memories 31 and 86. Both showed durable lift in first-week activation and completion rates. The situation requires addressing core funnel health rather than chasing competitor pricing; sustainable qualified revenue depends on converting and activating acquired accounts efficiently. Simplifying onboarding directly targets both declining metrics with precedent. I am verifying memories 31 and 86 to confirm the magnitude of prior lift and any cohort specificity before committing. Activation messaging (memory_91) is in reserve as complementary signal. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is deprioritized given SMB focus in current threat. Referral incentives (memory_57) and promotional pricing (memory_73) are deprioritized: referrals require healthy existing customer base (activation is down), and pricing competition is a velocity play that does not address the underlying activation decay.
